description: Generated by src/pretrain/data/generate_language_sets.py from fineweb2-language-distribution.csv (train-split UTF-8 bytes) and configs/tasks.json (benchmark availability) — do not edit by hand. Pool: FineWeb-2 subsets ranked by bytes, excluding und_* and hau_Latn (absent from the swiss-ai filtered dataset dir). Scheme ES: FW_L2 = [spa_Latn] instead of scheme A's top subset — the second-language intervention at L=2, the only setting this scheme defines, so FW_L2 is its only list.
